item.title: 'This is the home of a hero': Community strives to reopen historic home in Oberlin
item.description: The Wilson Bruce Evans Home Historical Society is a group working to restore the house and reopen it to the public as a historic site and educational center.

item.title: Summit County man waits for family's safe return from Mexico amid ongoing violence
item.description: A Summit County man told News 5 his flight was the last one to leave Puerto Vallarta on Sunday. Now, he’s patiently waiting for his family to make it back, too.

item.title: Midview superintendent accused of falsifying documents to justify spending
item.description: Midview Schools Superintendent Dr. Frank Major is accused of falsifying documents to justify personal use of a district credit card, according to a letter to parents from the school board president.
